name: std::flat_multimap<Key,T,Compare,KeyContainer,MappedContainer>::value_compare
intro: std::flat_multimap::value_compare is a function object that compares objects of type std::flat_multimap::const_reference (a pair of references to the stored key/value) by comparing the first components (i.e. keys) of the passed pairs.
